0: That is whole. This is whole. From the whole, the whole comes out. Take the whole from the whole, and the whole is what remains. Om, peace, peace, peace.
1: Cover all of this with the Lord, everything that moves in this moving world. Let it go, and sustain yourself that way. Do not reach for anyone's wealth.
2: Doing your work here, wish to live a hundred years. For you, as you are, there is no other way than this, and so the work does not cling to you.
3: There are worlds called sunless, wrapped in blind darkness. Those who kill the Self go to them after death.
4: It does not move. It is one, and faster than the mind. The senses never caught it; it was always ahead of them. Standing still, it passes all that run. In it the wind sets every action going.
5: It moves, and it does not move. It is far, and it is near. It is inside all of this, and it is outside all of this.
6: One who sees every being in the Self, and the Self in every being, shrinks from no one after that.
7: When every being has become the Self for one who knows, what confusion is left, and what grief, for one who sees that it is one?
8: He has gone everywhere. He is bright, without a body, without a wound, without sinews, pure, untouched by wrong. The seer, the knower of minds, present everywhere, born of himself, he set every thing in its right place for all the years to come.
9: Those who follow avidya enter blind darkness. Those who delight only in vidya enter a darkness deeper still.
10: One result comes from vidya, they say, and another from avidya. So we heard from the wise who explained it to us.
11: One who knows vidya and avidya together crosses death by avidya and reaches the deathless by vidya.
12: Those who worship the unmanifest enter blind darkness. Those who delight only in the manifest enter a darkness deeper still.
13: One result comes from the manifest, they say, and another from the unmanifest. So we heard from the wise who explained it to us.
14: One who knows the manifest and its passing away together crosses death by the passing away and reaches the deathless by the manifest.
15: The face of truth is hidden by a golden lid. Pushan, open it, so that I who hold to truth may see.
16: Pushan, lone traveller, Yama, Sun, child of Prajapati, spread your rays apart and draw in your blaze. I see your form, the most blessed one. That person there, I am he.
17: Let my breath go to the deathless air, and let this body end in ash. Om. Mind, remember. Remember what you have done. Mind, remember. Remember what you have done.
18: Agni, god who knows every way, lead us by the good road to what we have earned. Keep the crooked wrong away from us. We bow to you again and again in words.
